This example starts from one raw Visium DLPFC sample. 

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  fig.width = 10,
  fig.height = 7,
  dpi = 120,
  echo = TRUE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE
)

library(ssdr)
library(Seurat)
library(Matrix)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(uwot)

set.seed(1)
```

## Read counts and spatial positions

```{r data}
h5_path <- "../data/dlpfc_151673/151673_filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5"
positions_path <- "../data/dlpfc_151673/tissue_positions_list.txt"

counts <- Read10X_h5(h5_path)

positions <- read.csv(
  positions_path,
  header = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

colnames(positions) <- c(
  "barcode",
  "in_tissue",
  "array_row",
  "array_col",
  "pxl_row_in_fullres",
  "pxl_col_in_fullres"
)

positions <- positions[positions$in_tissue == 1, ]

barcodes <- intersect(colnames(counts), positions$barcode)

counts <- counts[, barcodes]
positions <- positions[match(barcodes, positions$barcode), ]

coords <- data.frame(
  x_pixel = positions$pxl_col_in_fullres,
  y_pixel = positions$pxl_row_in_fullres,
  row.names = positions$barcode
)
```

## Build the SSDr-F input



```{r ssdr-f-input}
seurat_f <- Seurat::CreateSeuratObject(counts = counts)
seurat_f <- Seurat::NormalizeData(seurat_f, verbose = FALSE)
seurat_f <- Seurat::FindVariableFeatures(
  seurat_f,
  selection.method = "vst",
  nfeatures = 2000,
  verbose = FALSE
)
seurat_f <- Seurat::ScaleData(
  seurat_f,
  features = Seurat::VariableFeatures(seurat_f),
  verbose = FALSE
)
seurat_f <- Seurat::RunPCA(
  seurat_f,
  features = Seurat::VariableFeatures(seurat_f),
  npcs = 15,
  verbose = FALSE
)

X_pca <- Seurat::Embeddings(seurat_f, "pca")
coords_f <- as.matrix(coords[rownames(X_pca), c("x_pixel", "y_pixel")])

dim(X_pca)
```

```{r ssdr-f}
fit_f <- ssdr_f(
  X = X_pca,
  coords = coords_f,
  rank = 8,
  bandwidth = 0.08,
  max_iter = 100,
  tol = 1e-2
)
```

## SSDr-NN 


```{r ssdr-nn-input}
seurat_nn <- Seurat::CreateSeuratObject(counts = counts)

seurat_nn <- Seurat::FindVariableFeatures(
  seurat_nn,
  selection.method = "vst",
  nfeatures = 1000,
  verbose = FALSE
)

nn_features <- Seurat::VariableFeatures(seurat_nn)

X_counts <- as.matrix(
  Matrix::t(counts[nn_features, Seurat::Cells(seurat_nn), drop = FALSE])
)

coords_nn <- as.matrix(coords[rownames(X_counts), c("x_pixel", "y_pixel")])

dim(X_counts)
```

```{r ssdr-nn}
fit_nn <- ssdr_nn(
  X = X_counts,
  coords = coords_nn,
  rank = 5,
  bandwidth = 0.15,
  lambda = 0.01,
  hidden_dim = 128,
  hidden_layers = 2,
  learning_rate = 0.003,
  max_iter = 150,
  patience = 40,
  tol = 1e-5,
  seed = 123
)
```

## Plot embeddings on the tissue


```{r helpers}
scale01 <- function(x) {
  rng <- range(x)
  if (rng[1] == rng[2]) {
    return(rep(0.5, length(x)))
  }
  (x - rng[1]) / (rng[2] - rng[1])
}

embedding_colours <- function(embedding) {
  umap <- uwot::umap(as.matrix(embedding), n_neighbors = 15, min_dist = 0.1)
  colnames(umap) <- c("UMAP1", "UMAP2")
  colour <- grDevices::rgb(
    red = scale01(umap[, "UMAP1"]),
    green = scale01(umap[, "UMAP2"]),
    blue = 0.3
  )
  list(umap = umap, colour = colour)
}

plot_umap <- function(map, title) {
  plot_data <- data.frame(map$umap, colour = map$colour)
  ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = UMAP1, y = UMAP2, colour = colour)) +
    geom_point(size = 0.45) +
    scale_colour_identity() +
    coord_equal() +
    labs(title = title, x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_void(base_size = 11) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5))
}

plot_spatial <- function(coords, colour, title) {
  plot_data <- data.frame(coords, colour = colour)
  ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = x_pixel, y = -y_pixel, colour = colour)) +
    geom_point(size = 0.45) +
    scale_colour_identity() +
    coord_equal() +
    labs(title = title, x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_void(base_size = 11) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5))
}
```

```{r spatial-plots}
pca_map <- embedding_colours(X_pca)
f_map <- embedding_colours(fit_f$U)
nn_map <- embedding_colours(fit_nn$U)

(plot_umap(pca_map, "PCA UMAP") | plot_spatial(coords_f, pca_map$colour, "PCA spatial")) /
  (plot_umap(f_map, "SSDr-F UMAP") | plot_spatial(coords_f, f_map$colour, "SSDr-F spatial")) /
  (plot_umap(nn_map, "SSDr-NN UMAP") | plot_spatial(coords_nn, nn_map$colour, "SSDr-NN spatial"))
```
